title: Abema Selects Project PRISMation's 1st Open Call Finalists to Make 3 Pilot Anime
content: The Japanese streaming service ABEMA announced the three finalists from the first open call in its " Project PRISMation " for independent animators on Friday. The three selected entries will each receive production funding for a short original anime pilot slated for next year or later.
author: ANN

title: A Tsujita Artisan Noodle X Umamusume Collab Starts November 12
content: Tsujita Artisan Noodle has announced a collaboration with the Umamusume: Pretty Derby franchise. The Tsujita Artisan Noodle x Umamusume collab runs from November 12 to December 20 at the restaurant’s Houston, Fort Lee, and Downtown Los Angeles locations.
author: Anime Corner

title: Mixed Media Project 'Harajuku Himegoto House' Announces TV Anime Adaptation
content: Entertainment company Plott announced a television anime adaptation of its Harajuku Himegoto House mixed-media project on Saturday, revealing the main cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 3 Years Ago, Attack on Titan Finale Proved Why It Remains a Modern Classic
content: When it comes to modern anime, specifically those released in the 2010s and 2020s, Attack on Titan’s legacy can’t be matched with anything else. Written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the manga reached its controversial finale in 2021, which sparked so much fury from fans that the creator was losing sleep over it.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Officially a Hit With Millions of Views
content: A new report confirms that Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 is one of the biggest hits of the year, not just on Netflix but among most of the anime released this year. The highly anticipated anime sequel was released last month after making fans wait for four years.
author: ComicBook

title: 25 Years Later, Cowboy Bebop Director Breaks Silence on the Biggest Challenge With the Anime
content: It’s been 25 years since the anime was released, but Shinichirō Watanabe’s Cowboy Bebop is still among one of the most popular shows of all time. The anime is commemorating a major milestone this year, which again brings the director into the spotlight as he shares updates on the upcoming 4K remastered version.
author: ComicBook

title: Beloved Fantasy’s Final Release Is the Biggest Hit of the Season Even Before Anime’s Return
content: Yona of the Dawn continues to grab fans’ attention even after its finale, thanks to the anime sequel confirmation and the manga’s final release. Based on an acclaimed manga series written and illustrated by Kusanagi Mizuho, the anime premiered in 2014.
author: ComicBook

title: Hana-Kimi Manga Gets New Live-Action Series, 1st Stage Play
content: Hisaya Nakajo 's classic shōjo manga Hana-Kimi ( Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e ) will receive both a new live-action television series and its first stage production to commemorate its 30th anniversary.
author: ANN

title: 2 Years Later, One Piece Finally Solves One of Its Biggest Mysteries About the Sun God and Luffy
content: The One Piece manga is currently deep into the action-packed climax of the Elbaph arc, delivering the necessary power upgrades to its main characters. However, amidst all the action, the series has not forgotten to resolve some of its underlying mysteries.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump’s Most Underrated Magical Action-Comedy Series Is Set to Take Over 2027
content: Shonen Jump ‘s most underrated magical action-comedy series, which debuted in 2020, is getting a special revival in 2027. Over the past few years, Shonen Jump magazine has undergone significant changes.
author: ComicBook
